limitations: Pattern scans are bounded and not exhaustive.
External URLs are not fetched by this checker.
Static checks do not establish ownership, legal validity, method quality or model behavior.
snapshot_scope: Final candidate tree before Git initialization; final commit/history audit retained outside the publishable tree.

release_checker_negative_controls.scope: Release-checker controls only; not Skill/model effectiveness

bundled_skill_quick_validator.reason: PyYAML unavailable in inspected Python environments; no installation performed
bundled_skill_quick_validator.fallback: Standard-library frontmatter, name, description and entrypoint checks executed
